### "Joy Comes in the Morning" Psalm 30:5 Meaning & Promise
Author: Joel Ryan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/joy-comes-in-the-morning-how-psalm-305-celebrates-resurrection.html
Passage: Psalm 30:5
Points:
- David experienced dramatic highs and lows, learning firsthand that suffering and sorrow are only temporary.
- Seasons of ease can lead to complacency, but God uses trials to humble and mature His people.
- Dark nights of grief cannot endure indefinitely because God's steadfast favor and dawn always break through.
- The morning joy promised in the psalm ultimately finds fulfillment in the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
- Trusting God in difficult seasons allows believers to anticipate the turning of mourning into gladness.
